atomic_operations.name: add_positional_encoding
atomic_operations.description: Adds sinusoidal (or learned) positional encodings to target token embeddings before entering the first decoder layer. Broadcasting across batch is used so each position receives a deterministic offset.

atomic_operations.name: embedding_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Applies dropout to the sum of embeddings and positional encodings for regularization. Disabled during inference.

atomic_operations.name: self_attention_query_projection
atomic_operations.description: Projects decoder states to query space for masked self-attention. Implemented as matrix multiplication followed by bias.

input_tensors.name: Y_l
input_tensors.description: Decoder states entering the self-attention sublayer of layer l

hyperparameters.name: per_layer_parameters
hyperparameters.description: Each decoder layer l has its own W and b

atomic_operations.name: self_attention_key_projection
atomic_operations.description: Projects decoder states to key space for masked self-attention.

input_tensors.name: Y_l
input_tensors.description: Decoder states entering the self-attention sublayer

atomic_operations.name: self_attention_value_projection
atomic_operations.description: Projects decoder states to value space for masked self-attention.

input_tensors.name: Y_l
input_tensors.description: Decoder states entering the self-attention sublayer

atomic_operations.name: self_q_split_heads
atomic_operations.description: Reshapes queries to split the last dimension into multiple heads and transposes to put heads before sequence length for efficient batched matmul.

atomic_operations.name: self_k_split_heads
atomic_operations.description: Reshapes keys into multi-head layout.

atomic_operations.name: self_v_split_heads
atomic_operations.description: Reshapes values into multi-head layout.

atomic_operations.name: self_keys_transpose_for_scores
atomic_operations.description: Transposes per-head keys for batched dot-product with queries.

atomic_operations.name: self_attention_scores
atomic_operations.description: Computes raw attention scores by multiplying queries with transposed keys for each head.

atomic_operations.name: self_attention_scale
atomic_operations.description: Scales scores by 1/sqrt(d_k) to stabilize the softmax for large d_k.

atomic_operations.name: build_look_ahead_mask
atomic_operations.description: Constructs a causal mask to prevent positions from attending to subsequent positions. 1 allows, 0 disallows.

atomic_operations.name: build_target_padding_mask
atomic_operations.description: Converts target key padding mask (True for valid tokens) into a broadcastable mask over heads and queries.

input_tensors.name: tgt_key_padding_mask
input_tensors.description: True for non-pad tokens, False for pad

atomic_operations.name: combine_self_masks
atomic_operations.description: Combines causal and padding masks using logical AND so a position is allowed only if both masks allow it.

atomic_operations.name: apply_self_attention_mask
atomic_operations.description: Applies the combined mask by adding a large negative number to disallowed positions before softmax.
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: Use -inf if dtype supports it to avoid NaNs in softmax.

atomic_operations.name: self_attention_softmax
atomic_operations.description: Row-wise softmax converts masked scores into attention probabilities along key dimension.

atomic_operations.name: self_attention_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Applies dropout to attention weights for regularization.

atomic_operations.name: self_weighted_sum_values
atomic_operations.description: Computes the context vectors as the weighted sum of per-head values using attention weights.

atomic_operations.name: self_concatenate_heads
atomic_operations.description: Merges the per-head context vectors back into a single representation per position.
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: Use contiguous() before view in frameworks like PyTorch.

atomic_operations.name: self_attention_output_projection
atomic_operations.description: Projects concatenated multi-head outputs back to model dimension.

atomic_operations.name: self_sublayer_output_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Dropout applied to the self-attention sublayer output before residual addition.

atomic_operations.name: self_residual_add
atomic_operations.description: Residual connection adds the sublayer output to its input.

atomic_operations.name: layer_norm_after_self
atomic_operations.description: Applies post-residual Layer Normalization across the last dimension.

atomic_operations.name: cross_attention_query_projection
atomic_operations.description: Projects decoder states to queries for encoder-decoder attention.

input_tensors.name: Y_l1
input_tensors.description: Normalized decoder states after self-attention sublayer

atomic_operations.name: cross_attention_key_projection
atomic_operations.description: Projects encoder outputs to keys for cross-attention.

atomic_operations.name: cross_attention_value_projection
atomic_operations.description: Projects encoder outputs to values for cross-attention.

atomic_operations.name: cross_split_heads_queries_keys_values
atomic_operations.description: Reshapes and transposes Q, K, V for multi-head cross-attention.

atomic_operations.name: cross_keys_transpose_for_scores
atomic_operations.description: Transposes keys for batched dot-product with queries in cross-attention.

atomic_operations.name: cross_attention_scores
atomic_operations.description: Computes attention scores between decoder queries and encoder keys.

atomic_operations.name: cross_attention_scale
atomic_operations.description: Scales cross-attention scores by 1/sqrt(d_k).
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: Scaling helps keep logits in a numerically stable range.

atomic_operations.name: build_source_padding_mask
atomic_operations.description: Broadcasts the encoder key padding mask (True=non-pad) for use in cross-attention.

atomic_operations.name: apply_cross_attention_mask
atomic_operations.description: Applies the source padding mask to cross-attention scores by adding a large negative value to masked positions.
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: Prefer -inf if supported; ensure broadcasting over heads and queries.

atomic_operations.name: cross_attention_softmax
atomic_operations.description: Row-wise softmax across encoder positions to obtain attention weights for each target position.

atomic_operations.name: cross_attention_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Dropout over cross-attention weights.

atomic_operations.name: cross_weighted_sum_values
atomic_operations.description: Aggregates encoder values using cross-attention weights to produce per-head context vectors for each target position.

atomic_operations.name: cross_concatenate_heads
atomic_operations.description: Concatenates all heads of cross-attention outputs back to model dimension.
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: Ensure contiguous memory layout before view.

atomic_operations.name: cross_attention_output_projection
atomic_operations.description: Final linear projection of cross-attention outputs to model space.

atomic_operations.name: cross_sublayer_output_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Dropout applied to cross-attention sublayer output before residual addition.

atomic_operations.name: cross_residual_add
atomic_operations.description: Residual addition for cross-attention sublayer.

atomic_operations.name: layer_norm_after_cross
atomic_operations.description: Applies Layer Normalization after cross-attention residual addition.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_linear_1
atomic_operations.description: First position-wise linear layer expands the channel dimension from d_model to d_ff.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_relu_activation
atomic_operations.description: Applies ReLU nonlinearity element-wise.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_linear_2
atomic_operations.description: Second position-wise linear layer projects back to d_model.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_output_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Applies dropout to FFN output before residual addition.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_residual_add
atomic_operations.description: Adds FFN output to its input (residual connection).

atomic_operations.name: layer_norm_after_ffn
atomic_operations.description: Applies Layer Normalization after the FFN residual addition to produce the layer output.
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: Keep epsilon not too small to avoid division blow-ups.

composite_operations.name: Masked Multi-Head Self-Attention Sublayer (with Add & Norm)
composite_operations.description: Computes causal self-attention over the decoder sequence, followed by residual addition and LayerNorm.
composite_operations.why_grouped: These steps always occur together to implement masked self-attention and the standard Add & Norm wrapper.

composite_operations.name: Encoder-Decoder Multi-Head Attention Sublayer (with Add & Norm)
composite_operations.description: Attends to encoder memory using queries from the decoder and applies Add & Norm.
composite_operations.overall_formula: Y_l^{(2)} = \mathrm{LayerNorm}\Big(Y_l^{(1)} + \mathrm{Dropout}\big(\mathrm{ConcatHeads}(\mathrm{softmax}((Q_c K_c^T/\sqrt{d_k}) + \log M_{src}) V_c) W_O^c + b_O^c\big)\Big)
composite_operations.why_grouped: This forms the cross-attention module that integrates encoder context into the decoder.

composite_operations.name: Position-wise Feed-Forward Network Sublayer (with Add & Norm)
composite_operations.description: Two linear layers with ReLU activation applied independently to each position, followed by Add & Norm.
composite_operations.why_grouped: These operations are the canonical FFN sublayer encapsulated by Add & Norm.

tensor_transformations.purpose: Split model dimension into num_heads parallel heads for self-attention.
Merge per-head outputs back to model dimension.
Prepare Q, K, V for cross-attention batched matmul.
Broadcast key padding mask across heads and query positions.

special_cases.description: All dropout operations are disabled; tensors pass through unchanged.
special_cases.example: torch.nn.Dropout(p)(x) returns x when module.eval() is set.

special_cases.condition: Autoregressive incremental decoding with KV caching
special_cases.description: Cache past keys and values for self-attention to avoid O(t^2) recomputation; masks restrict to seen positions only.
special_cases.example: K_cache = concat(K_cache, K_t); V_cache = concat(V_cache, V_t); scores = Q_t @ K_cache^T; mask only future positions relative to current step.

special_cases.condition: Empty or all-pad positions in source/target
special_cases.description: Ensure masked rows become all -inf before softmax; replace with zeros to avoid NaNs.
Swap ReLU with GELU if specified by a variant; shapes and other steps unchanged.
special_cases.example: H' = GELU(H) with approximate tanh formulation.

implementation_hints.description: Each decoder layer l has its own Q/K/V and FFN parameters; do not share across layers unless explicitly desired.
implementation_hints.code_snippet: for l in range(N): Y = decoder_layer[l](Y, Z, tgt_mask, src_mask)

implementation_hints.description: Build masks in bool, then convert to the attention score dtype for additive masking. Ensure shapes broadcast to [B, H, T, T] or [B, H, T, S].
Subtract row-wise max before exponentiation; leverage fused kernels if available.
implementation_hints.code_snippet: scores = scores - scores.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values; attn = scores.softmax(-1)

implementation_hints.description: Use library-provided scaled_dot_product_attention to fuse matmuls, scaling, masking, softmax, dropout, and weighted sum.
implementation_hints.code_snippet: ctx = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(Q, K, V, attn_mask=mask, dropout_p=0.1 if training else 0.0)

implementation_hints.description: Fuse Q/K/V projections with a single matmul and then split; enable gradient checkpointing across layers for long sequences.
implementation_hints.code_snippet: qkv = torch.matmul(Y, W_qkv) + b_qkv; Q, K, V = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1)

implementation_hints.description: Keep residual paths in full precision (fp32) if training in mixed precision. Apply gradient clipping at the stack output.
This spec uses post-norm (LayerNorm(x + Sublayer(x))) per the paper. If switching to pre-norm, move LayerNorm before each sublayer and remove after residual.
